text:
michael.sales: Hey team — Foxtrot Health asked for a quick package to unblock their POC. They want SSO + role mapping proof and confirmation MFA will be enforced for all service users. I can share some stuff but want to make sure we send the right artifacts. Can we confirm what to include?

sara.security: +1. At minimum: SAML metadata, example assertion payload, a short note on MFA enforcement (provider + policy), and a CSV of role mappings showing least-privilege defaults. Also include service-account rules for API keys.

josh.eng: I can export metadata.xml and an example saml response (redacted). For MFA we use Okta + adaptive MFA; I'll paste a short blurb we can reuse.

anya.devx: Heads-up — customer asks specifically for an example assertion with groups and email attributes. Suggest we include a small snippet and a mapping table. Keep it short.

paul.solutions: I'll pull the RBAC CSV mapping we used in the last POC (redwood-role, foxtrot-role, permissions). We should call out default "read-only" role for new orgs to satisfy least-privilege questions.

michael.sales: Cool. Can someone draft the few lines for MFA enforcement? They might want an audit trail too.

sara.security: MFA note (short): "Redwood requires multi-factor authentication for all human user accounts. We enforce MFA via Okta sign-on policies with a minimum of two factors (password + TOTP or WebAuthn). Adaptive rules escalate for high-risk locations. MFA enforcement for SSO->SAML logins is enforced at the IdP level; for non-SSO accounts we require MFA at Redwood Console auth. Audit: we retain authentication events (success/failure) and MFA challenges for 365 days in our audit logs (exportable)."

josh.eng: Sample SAML attribute snippet we can include:
```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="email">
    <saml:AttributeValue>user@example.com</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name="groups">
    <saml:AttributeValue>org:admin</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

anya.devx: For role mapping CSV, use columns: customer_group, redwood_role, description. Small sample:
```csv
customer_group,redwood_role,description
engineering,admin,full access to app + deployments
readonly,viewer,view-only access to models and metrics
platform,editor,can create routes and configs
```

paul.solutions: Also call out service accounts: they can be created with scoped API keys limited to routes/models via policy. Example policy name: `model-infer:read-only` — keys are rotatable and we recommend lifetime <= 30 days for POC.

michael.sales: Great. Anything about delegated sessions / SAML assertion expiration/time window? Customer security asked about assertion lifetime.

sara.security: We recommend assertions <= 5 minutes validity and enforce `Recipient`/`Audience` checks against our ACS URL. We also validate `InResponseTo` when set. Add that line to the package.

josh.eng: I'll attach metadata.xml and a redacted saml-response.txt to the doc bundle. I'll also include the sample `acs` and `entityID` values they should configure.

paul.solutions: I'll draft the one-page package and upload to the POC folder. Plan: metadata + sample assertion + MFA blurb + RBAC CSV + service-account guidance + audit retention statement. Should be under 2 pages.

michael.sales: Perfect — timeline? Foxtrot wants artifacts before their security call tomorrow afternoon. Can we get a bundle by EOD?

deploy-bot: Reminder: shared-drive upload quota at 93% — attach files directly to the case and ping me if you need a signed transfer. :thumbsup:

anya.devx: I can do a quick review after Josh/Paul upload. If we need a formal attestation, escalate to Sara and I'll route it to GRC.

sara.security: Will be on standby. If they ask for logs export format, point them to our audit-export schema (CSV/JSON) — we support date-range exports via Support.

michael.sales: Thanks all — tagging Foxtrot contact in the POC ticket now. I'll close once bundle is uploaded.
